repos.name: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
repos.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
repos.eli5: It builds a map that tells smart programs where data lives and what it means, like a library catalog for a company's information, so AI can find the right facts quickly.

repos.name: max-sixty/worktrunk
repos.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
repos.eli5: It helps you juggle many copies of a project at once, like having several workstations for different robot helpers, making it easy to switch and keep track of changes.

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.eli5: It gives tiny cheat‑sheets that AI helpers can use to do real engineering tasks, like a toolbox of simple tricks for a robot builder.

repos.name: floci-io/floci
repos.description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative
repos.eli5: It pretends to be Amazon's cloud services on your own computer, so you can test things without paying or needing an internet connection, like a play kitchen for cloud tools.

repos.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.eli5: It remembers everything an AI did before and writes a short summary, so the next time the AI can pick up where it left off, like a notebook that a robot writes in between shifts.

repos.name: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
repos.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
repos.eli5: It lets an AI see and click on things on your computer by reading the app's layout, like giving a robot eyes that understand the buttons instead of just pictures.

repos.name: github/spec-kit
repos.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with SDD or any other process!
repos.eli5: It provides ready‑made step‑by‑step plans for AI to build or fix software, like a recipe book that tells a cooking robot exactly what to do.

repos.name: The-PR-Agent/pr-agent
repos.description: 🚀 PR Agent: The Original Open-Source PR Reviewer. This project is not the Qodo free tier.
repos.eli5: It automatically checks code changes and gives feedback, like a teacher that reads your homework and points out mistakes right away.

repos.name: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repos.eli5: It creates short videos from a simple idea by writing a script, finding pictures, and adding music, like a magic video‑making machine you tell what you want.

repos.name: garrytan/gstack
repos.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
